# function: pipeline_yaml

Decodes an Orchestra pipeline YAML document into the value `orchestra_pipeline`'s `data` takes. Pass it `file(...)` or `templatefile(...)`. Entries under `pipeline` with a `tasks` key become `task_groups` and the rest `tasks`, and free-form fields such as `parameters` are JSON-encoded. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Usually the YAML is in its own file: pipeline_yaml(file("${path.module}/daily_sales.yml")).
resource "orchestra_pipeline" "daily_sales" {
  alias     = "daily_sales"
  published = true

  data = provider::orchestra::pipeline_yaml(<<-YAML
    version: v1
    name: Daily sales
    schedule:
      - name: nightly
        cron: "0 2 * * ? *"
        timezone: Europe/London
    pipeline:
      ingest:
        integration: FIVETRAN
        integration_job: FIVETRAN_SYNC_ALL
        parameters:
          connector_id: warehouse_orders
  YAML
  )
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
pipeline_yaml(yaml string) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `yaml` (String) The pipeline YAML document.
